title: DeepResearchAdvocate
description: Devil's-advocate sidecar. Cumulative across all 3 advocate runs (own-numbered Checkpoints 1, 2, 3 — mapping to pipeline Phases 1, 3, 5 per agents/advocate.md §3 Mandatory Checkpoints). First run creates the file; subsequent runs append to findings[]. Compiler reads this at Phase 4 to ensure unresolved CRITICAL findings block report assembly. Validated by skills/deep-research/scripts/validate_sidecar.py + predicates A1-A3.

mode.description: Modes that emit advocate.json per SIDECAR_SPECS. 'quick' and 'socratic' omitted — they do not invoke the advocate agent.

checkpoints_run.description: Which advocate checkpoints have been executed so far. Advocate has 3 own-numbered runs (Checkpoint 1 = post-scoping/Phase 1; Checkpoint 2 = post-analysis/Phase 3; Checkpoint 3 = final review/Phase 5). See agents/advocate.md §3 Mandatory Checkpoints.

id.description: Advocate finding ID. Pattern A-NNN, allocated sequentially across checkpoints.

checkpoint.description: Which of the advocate's 3 own-numbered checkpoint runs emitted this finding (Checkpoint 1 = post-scoping/Phase 1; Checkpoint 2 = post-analysis/Phase 3; Checkpoint 3 = final review/Phase 5).

affected_paper_ids.description: paper_ids from sources.json that this finding implicates. Optional — some findings (e.g. logic_chain) are document-level.

severity.description: A3: CRITICAL findings with status == 'open' MUST block compiler assembly.

resolution_note.description: Required when status != 'open'. Documents how the finding was addressed (or why deferred).
